    Effect size tibbles

    Source: R/classes-vctrs.R
    new_meta_es.Rd

    new_meta_es() is the low-level constructor for the <meta_es> class, a tibble subclass that stores study level effect sizes (.yi), sampling variances (.vi) and standard errors (.sei) together with the effect size metric. as_meta_es() turns a data frame that already holds effect sizes into a <meta_es>. is_meta_es() tests for the class.

    Usage

    new_meta_es(
  x = list(.yi = double(), .vi = double(), .sei = double()),
  measure = "GEN",
  study = NULL
)

as_meta_es(.data, yi, vi = NULL, sei = NULL, measure = "GEN", study = NULL)

is_meta_es(x)

    Arguments

    x

    A list or data frame of columns that includes .yi, .vi and .sei.

    measure

    A string naming the effect size metric, for example "SMD" or "OR".

    study

    For new_meta_es(), the name of the column holding study labels, or NULL. For as_meta_es(), a <tidy-select> expression selecting that column.

    .data

    A data frame.

    yi, vi, sei

    <data-masking> Columns holding effect sizes and either sampling variances (vi) or standard errors (sei).

    Value

    new_meta_es() and as_meta_es() return a <meta_es> tibble. is_meta_es() returns a single logical value.

    Details

    The class survives dplyr verbs such as dplyr::filter(), dplyr::mutate() and dplyr::arrange(). If an operation removes .yi or .vi, the result falls back to a plain tibble.

    Examples

    dat <- data.frame(id = 1:3, g = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.1), v = c(0.04, 0.02, 0.05))
es <- as_meta_es(dat, yi = g, vi = v, study = id)
es
#> # A meta_es: 3 rows x 6 columns
#> # Measure:   generic effect size
#>      id     g     v   .yi   .vi  .sei
#>   <int> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1     1   0.2  0.04   0.2  0.04 0.2  
#> 2     2   0.5  0.02   0.5  0.02 0.141
#> 3     3   0.1  0.05   0.1  0.05 0.224
is_meta_es(es)
#> [1] TRUE
